Cabin

Carrinho de bebidas

A service cart used by cabin crew to serve drinks and light refreshments to passengers during the flight, stowed in the galley when not in use.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Carrinho de bebidas?

In this glossary, Carrinho de bebidas refers to: A service cart used by cabin crew to serve drinks and light refreshments to passengers during the flight, stowed in the galley when not in use.

How is Carrinho de bebidas used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Tripulação de cabine, garantam que todos os carrinhos de bebidas estejam travados no galley antes do táxi e pouso."

Why does Carrinho de bebidas matter in aviation?

Carrinho de bebidas matters because it supports clear communication in Cabin contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Carrinho de bebidas is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

Definition

A service cart used by cabin crew to serve drinks and light refreshments to passengers during the flight, stowed in the galley when not in use.

Operational example
